name: usha_bgm_soft
caption: Soft calm devotional dawn instrumental, no vocals. Warm sitar and gentle veena plucks playing a slow simple tender melody over a deep tanpura drone, soft sustained string pad, light tabla and very soft bells, no flute, no shehnai, no harsh or high-pitched sounds, smooth, gentle, warm, peaceful, emotional but not dramatic, slowly building to a quiet glowing sunrise feeling, fades softly at the end. Indian classical ambient, cinematic, heartfelt, serene, no electronic sounds, no drops.
